items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Teddy and Lionel were from '38 on -- they were already with Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: Right. And was he hired after Benny Goodman had hired Teddy Wilson?
Teddy and Lionel were from '38 on -- they were already with Benny Goodman.
Yes, but Teddy Wilson was the first black musician to be hired by a white band. That's a matter of record, I believe.
